CARDIAC_ARREST.line_1_directive: Don't panic. 911 CAD dispatch has been alerted with your exact GPS location. We need to start CPR immediately! Lay them flat on firm ground.
CARDIAC_ARREST.clarifying_probe: Is the patient breathing normally, yes or no?
training_phrases: dad fell down and won't wake up
gasping for air strange snoring noise
making terrible grunting sounds not responsive
help he is dead not breathing
he passed out and has no pulse
sans nahi aa rahi behosh hai

ARTERIAL_BLEED.line_1_directive: Call 911 on speaker now! Bleeding protocol locked. Rip or cut away clothing immediately to expose the bare wound.
ARTERIAL_BLEED.clarifying_probe: Is blood spurting or pooling rapidly, yes or no?
training_phrases: stabbed in the leg bleeding heavily

CHOKING.line_1_directive: Stand behind them. Wrap your arms around their waist. If they can cough or speak, encourage them to keep coughing.
CHOKING.clarifying_probe: Can the person make any sound or cough, yes or no?
training_phrases: he is choking and turning red
gala band ho gaya hai kuch phans gaya hai

ANAPHYLAXIS.line_1_directive: Severe allergic reaction locked. Find their EpiPen or epinephrine auto-injector immediately!
ANAPHYLAXIS.clarifying_probe: Is their throat swelling or are they struggling to breathe, yes or no?
training_phrases: ate nuts face is swelling up
allergy ki wajah se gala band ho raha hai

OVERDOSE.line_1_directive: Opioid overdose locked. Check if Narcan or Naloxone nasal spray is available in the house.
OVERDOSE.clarifying_probe: Are their pupils tiny like pinpoints, yes or no?
training_phrases: took too many pills pinpoint pupils
drug overdose lips blue shallow breathing
passed out with empty pill bottle
bohot sari dawaiyan kha li hain behosh hai
